profile.headline: Senior Staff Data / Software Engineer at Slack

positions.title: Senior Staff Data / Software Engineer
positions.description:
SENIOR STAFF ENGINEER (7/2023 - Current)
• Founded and led development of LENS log registry and Woodpecker 2.0 real-time debugging tool serving PMs, engineers, and data scientists; designed YAML-based tracking plan framework managing thousands of unique log types with automated validation to reduce logging and metric breakages
• Led Merlin Metrics Framework enhancements including experiment metric consolidation, database upgrades, improved pipeline reliability, and multi-year roadmap for unified metric platform consolidating fragmented tooling
• Championed Project Cobbler establishing baseline KPIs for Data Engineering including On-Time Performance, Data Quality Score, Cost metrics, and Apdex scores, enabling significant improvements

STAFF ENGINEER (8/2019 - 7/2023)
• Tech Lead for Data Tools & Platform team responsible for internally developed data query & dashboard platform, experimentation, metric creation & calculation
• Built experimentation analytics framework to achieve a 95% improvement in dashboard performance 
• Led development of Merlin Metrics Framework to unify metric calculations across the company improving trust in data, shared language for data conversations, and metric performance
• Supported launch and ongoing development of internal JupyterHub notebook platform
• Led & mentored multiple junior engineers in building data pipelining frameworks, paying down technical debt, improving agile practices
• Improved and maintained Slack's centralized BI tool, responsible for dashboarding, querying, exploration of the data warehouse, experimentation, alerting, data pipelining, metadata management, and search & discovery

SENIOR DATA ENGINEER (10/2018 - 8/2019)
• Implemented framework to support large backfills of data that reduced backfill time by 98% (usually from days / weeks to hours)
• Implemented performance, reliability and quality reporting that identified gaps leading to SLA improvements from 72% to 90%

positions.title: Senior Director of Data / Software Engineering
positions.description:
SENIOR DIRECTOR OF DATA / SOFTWARE ENGINEERING (July 2016 - October 2018)
•	Managed development of metric calculation application to support Mosaic product that improved calculation speed by 90% and decreased failures by 75%
•	Led product team in development of Python (Flask) RESTful micro-services to support Schoolzilla’s data infrastructure
•	Oversaw product initiatives that helped transition Schoolzilla from selling a data warehouse as a service to a web-based analytics product
•	Improved developer culture and happiness by transitioning team to Agile and taking on Scrum Master responsibilities which resulted in consistently releasing product increments on a biweekly basis and doubling our velocity year over year
•	Led projects to consolidate codebase, improve developer capacity and save on monthly hosting costs


DATA / SOFTWARE ENGINEERING MANAGER (April 2015 - June 2016)
•	Created Python (Flask) application to manage database objects across all customer environments
•	Directed major data model migration that drastically improved query performance across our data warehouse
•	Developed data pipeline framework that improved integration development from 3-6 weeks to ~1 week
•	Managed team of 4-8 engineers in supporting our data warehouse product
•	Led analytic product Community of Practice sessions to help improve technical capacity and learning of junior engineers

ANALYTICS ENGINEER (January 2014 - April 2015)	
•	Created powerful data visualizations in Tableau to help educators make data-driven decisions for students
•	Designed Schoolzilla’s grades and behavior data models which allow teachers, principals, and data analysts the ability to quickly determine trends with a combination of Tableau reports and data sources
•	Helped customers use Schoolzilla’s data analysis tools to answer big, complex, important questions
•	Built SQL data pipelines from varied data sources in Schoolzilla’s data warehouse

positions.title: Customer Advisory Board Member
positions.description:
•	Advised educational technology company that created a tool to track behavior and achievement in new feature developments and implementation.
•	Presented at education conferences on how to use behavior data to analyze behavioral trends at the student, classroom, and school-level, plan and evaluate individualized interventions, and maintain a positive school climate.

positions.title: Program Analyst
positions.description:
DATA ANALYST (June 2012 - June 2014)
•	Developed a tool to automate sending out reports, charts and progress to all teachers and school leaders on a weekly basis.
•	Automated logistical aspects of teachers and deans’ jobs so that teachers can spend more time in the classroom helping students and deans can spend more time improving teachers’ instruction.
•	Created and implemented three school-wide systemic shifts that increased student behavioral and academic accountability at school that improved its state test scores by 7% in 2012-2013.
•	De-escalated and supported frustrated students in Elm City’s Reflection Room while teaching them coping skills so that they could get back to their classrooms as quickly as possible.
•	Managed the consequence and data collection process of all student behavior incidents.

ENGLISH LANGUAGE ARTS TEACHER (September 2010 - June 2012)
•	Led reading/writing classes to attain an average of two years of reading growth in one year.
•	Planned rigorous curriculum resulting in an average of 83% content mastery in both reading and writing as measured by the state end-of-grade assessment. 
•	Advised 12-student group in character values and interpersonal skills.

positions.title: Corps Member
positions.description: Served as a member of highly selective national service corps of recent college graduates of all academic majors who commit two years to teach in underserved communities.
